title: Indian-Style Reblochon Tart
description: A creamy, savory tart perfect for dinner, inspired by Indian cuisine. The reblochon cheese adds a rich, nutty flavor.
instructions: Roll out the puff pastry to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Transfer the pastry to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
In a skillet, sauté the sliced onions over medium heat until lightly caramelized.
Sprinkle the garam masala and cumin seeds over the onions; stir to combine.
Place the reblochon cheese on one half of the pastry, leaving a 1/2-inch border around the edges.
Top the cheese with the onion mixture.
Fold the other half of the pastry over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Brush the pastry with a little water and sprinkle with salt (if using).
Bake the tart for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
